strategy_goal: Reason about what the target project should expose to and consume from peer applications.

cross_project_context.context_note: Analytics Hub publishes feedback batches for downstream strategy consumers.
Runtime orchestrator ingests replay manifests before scheduling shared recovery work.

project_obligation_candidates.summary: Expose replay manifest packets to runtime orchestrator.

contract_expectations.summary: Publish a deterministic replay manifest with commit and artifact references.

ownership_boundary.boundary_rule: Current project owns manifest generation and schema stability; runtime orchestrator owns downstream scheduling.

project_obligation_candidates.rationale: Runtime orchestration depends on a stable manifest contract to pick up replay evidence from this project.
project_obligation_candidates.next_step: Attach the replay manifest contract to the runtime handoff packet.

project_obligation_candidates.summary: Consume analytics feedback packets from Analytics Hub.

contract_expectations.summary: Ingest analytics feedback batches keyed by task identifier and contract version.

ownership_boundary.boundary_rule: Analytics Hub owns batch production and freshness; current project owns ingestion validation and routing.

project_obligation_candidates.rationale: Feedback packets from Analytics Hub define what external observations this project should consume before promoting strategy changes.
project_obligation_candidates.next_step: Pin the analytics feedback queue consumer to the documented v2 contract.

project_obligation_candidates.summary: Expose deployment drift summaries to deployment controller.

contract_expectations.summary: Emit a deployment drift summary for rollout gating decisions.

ownership_boundary.boundary_rule: Current project owns drift summary emission; deployment controller owns rollout gating.

project_obligation_candidates.rationale: Deployment-controller integration stays unresolved until the peer project context is confirmed.
project_obligation_candidates.next_step: Collect deployment-controller context before publishing the drift summary contract.
